entries.name: Program
entries.comment: Root of the backend control tree: the program itself.

entries.name: NativeEtwLifetimeService
entries.comment: Owns the lifetime of the three native ETW producer flows.

entries.name: TrustedAccessRequestOwner
entries.comment: Maintains and publishes pending requests for trusted access.

entries.name: TrustedAccessInvocationHostedService
entries.comment: Processes trusted invocations from external callers and publishes their results.

entries.name: RuntimeSpecializationCoordinator
entries.comment: Publishes the compiled runtime plan used by backend services.

entries.name: AutomaticProductUpdateService
entries.comment: Checks for automatic product updates and produces update decisions in the Windows service host.

entries.name: HostManagerSamplingSubscriptionOwner
entries.comment: Owns the shared workspace for sampling subscriptions.

entries.name: HostManagerMetricSnapshotOwner
entries.comment: Owns the workspace that publishes current metric snapshots.

entries.name: HostManagerSoftwareIdentityOwner
entries.comment: Owns the workspace that produces resolved software identities.

entries.name: HostManagerFileQueryOwner
entries.comment: Owns the workspace that provides file queries and their results.

entries.name: HostManagerDisplayCoordinatorOwner
entries.comment: Owns the workspace that publishes display topology.

entries.name: HostManagerPublicServiceCoordinatorOwner
entries.comment: Owns the workspace that produces public service tasks.

entries.name: HostManagerOperationCoordinatorOwner
entries.comment: Owns the workspace that produces requested operation results.

entries.name: SqlitePortableSoftwareRegistry
entries.comment: Maintains the persistent registry of portable software.

entries.name: ServiceAutoStartSettings
entries.comment: Maintains the configured service automatic startup policy.

entries.name: ServiceRecoverySettings
entries.comment: Maintains the configured service recovery policy.

entries.name: ControlDesiredStateReassertion
entries.comment: Reapplies the desired state of hardware controls when required.

entries.name: FanCurveTemperatureFeed
entries.comment: Feeds sampled temperatures to software fan curves.

entries.name: ControlActualStateReader
entries.comment: Samples the actual state of hardware controls.

entries.name: FanControlCoreLifetimeService
entries.comment: Owns and provides the native fan control runtime.

entries.name: KernelEtwSessionBroker
entries.comment: Owns the shared kernel ETW session and provides its kernel events to consumers.

entries.name: PortableSoftwareDiscoveryService
entries.comment: Discovers portable software from observed process activity.

entries.name: EtwPhysicalDiskIoAttributionReader
entries.comment: Attributes physical disk activity from kernel ETW events.

entries.name: EtwNetworkTcpIpAttributionReader
entries.comment: Attributes TCP/IP network activity from kernel ETW events.

entries.name: GpuPlacementProcessHistoryObserver
entries.comment: Produces graphics API history for processes, used for GPU placement.

entries.name: SharedResourceSubscriptionMaintenanceService
entries.comment: Maintains shared resource subscriptions and their expiration.

entries.name: JsonDebugDiagnosticLogWriter
entries.comment: Writes diagnostic snapshots to the debug log.

entries.name: HostManagerReportCoordinatorOwner
entries.comment: Owns the workspace that produces reports.

entries.name: HostManagerSmartCoordinator
entries.comment: Coordinates the active optimization runtime and produces optimization decisions.

entries.name: PresentFrameEtwSource
entries.comment: Produces frame timing and graphics API observations from Present ETW events.

entries.name: GpuAllocationCollector
entries.comment: Produces GPU allocation observations from native ETW sessions.

entries.name: DxgkrnlVidMmEtwTelemetryZone
entries.comment: Produces GPU memory residual evidence from VidMm ETW events.

entries.name: DeviceTopologySnapshotProvider
entries.comment: Publishes current device topology snapshots.

entries.name: GpuTelemetryWorkerSupervisor
entries.comment: Supervises native GPU sampling workers and publishes their GPU metrics.

entries.name: WindowsHardwareMetricSampler
entries.comment: Samples hardware metrics on Windows.

entries.name: CpuTopologySnapshotProvider
entries.comment: Publishes current CPU topology snapshots.

entries.name: EtwCpuCoreResidencyReader
entries.comment: Samples CPU core residency from kernel ETW observations.

entries.name: EtwSystemInterruptSnapshotSource
entries.comment: Publishes interrupt activity snapshots from kernel ETW observations.

entries.name: WindowsResourceBreakdownSampler
entries.comment: Publishes resource use snapshots and their per-process breakdown.

entries.name: Program
entries.comment: Root of the UI control trees: the program itself.

entries.name: MainRoot
entries.comment: Owns the main UI service tree.

entries.name: TrayRoot
entries.comment: Owns the independent system tray tree.

entries.name: SingleInstance
entries.comment: Receives requests through the single-instance UI channel.

entries.name: BackendConnection
entries.comment: Maintains the current backend session and reconnects after session loss.

entries.name: MainWindow
entries.comment: Owns the main application window lifetime.

entries.name: DesktopObservation
entries.comment: Observes desktop activity using the current backend session.

entries.name: Overlay
entries.comment: Owns the performance overlay lifetime.

entries.name: LoopbackProxy
entries.comment: Owns the loopback proxy used by the main window.

entries.name: WebViewHost
entries.comment: Owns the embedded browser lifetime.

entries.name: TrayNotifications
entries.comment: Observes backend notifications for the system tray.

entries.name: BlockDemand
entries.comment: Whether a block currently has external demand. Demand updates provide the change event.

entries.name: ProgramShuttingDown
entries.comment: Whether terminal backend shutdown has begun. The host stopping turn publishes this event.

entries.name: PresentNativeSessionAvailable
entries.comment: Whether the Present native ETW session is available. The process-wide publisher marks it unavailable after an unconfirmed release, permission refusal or exhausted session capacity.

entries.name: GpuAllocationNativeSessionAvailable
entries.comment: Whether the GPU allocation native ETW session is available. The process-wide publisher marks it unavailable after an unconfirmed release, permission refusal or exhausted session capacity.

entries.name: VidMmNativeSessionAvailable
entries.comment: Whether the VidMm native ETW session is available. The process-wide publisher marks it unavailable after an unconfirmed release, permission refusal or exhausted session capacity.

entries.name: PresentUnfrozen
entries.comment: Whether the Present compute zone is not frozen. Applying a mode publishes the change event.

entries.name: VidMmUnfrozen
entries.comment: Whether the VidMm compute zone is not frozen. Applying a mode publishes the change event.

entries.name: ProgramShuttingDown
entries.comment: Whether terminal UI shutdown has begun. The UI exit path publishes this event.

entries.name: ProgramStarted
entries.comment: Whether the UI process has started its control trees. The startup path publishes this event.

entries.name: WindowWanted
entries.comment: Whether the user currently wants the main window open. Window requests publish change events.

entries.name: BackendSessionReady
entries.comment: Whether the current backend session is ready. The backend connection flow publishes session transition events.

entries.name: HostMemoryProtection
entries.comment: Host memory protection: holds commit and process subscriptions and acts when commit reaches the threshold.

entries.name: HostMemoryProtectionEnabled
entries.comment: Whether the user enabled host memory protection. Settings changes publish the event.

entries.name: MemoryProtectionNormalRunningPointExists
entries.comment: Whether a normal running point exists for this service run. Creating a point publishes the event.

entries.name: MemoryProtectionReserveBuilt
entries.comment: Whether every configured disk reserve entry is fully built. Reserve configuration and rebuild publish the event.

entries.name: CpuThreadDiagnosticRequests
entries.comment: Per-request target process identities and query-only thread handles; explicit diagnostic demand only. Disposing the holder closes all handles.

entries.name: CpuProcessThreadWindow
entries.comment: Requested process closed ETW execution window with optional raw thread identity, name, start module and separately bounded Windows user/kernel counter deltas.

entries.name: AppSettingsCurrent
entries.comment: Current normalized persisted backend settings, published only by JsonAppSettingsStore.

entries.name: StartupModuleSettingsCurrent
entries.comment: Current injected-module selections, published only by JsonStartupModuleSettingsStore.
